items.h: Sterling Shepard catches two TDs in Week 11
items.s: Sterling Shepard caught both of his targets for 24 yards and two touchdowns in a 27-24 win over the Chargers in Week 11. Shepard was elevated from the practice squad on Saturday and promptly went on to catch two touchdown passes from Geno Smith in the close win. The Jets were in need of his services, with Omar Cooper Jr. missing the game with an ankle injury and Isaiah Williams (ribs) also sidelined. It remains to be seen if Shepard will stick on the active roster even after Cooper and Williams are ready to return.

items.h: First career two-TD game in win
items.s: Shepard caught two passes for 24 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers. With Omar Cooper (ankle) and Isaiah Williams (ribs) inactive, Shepard was elevated from the practice squad and logged 22 of 60 offensive snaps. He ran 13 routes on Geno Smith's 23 dropbacks and obviously made the most of his two targets. In his 120th career regular-season game, it was Shepard's first career two-touchdown performance. It's unlikely to be indicative of future performance.
The Jets elevated WR Sterling Shepard for Sunday's game against the Chargers. Shepard will add depth in the wide receiver room for the Jets. He'll remain off the fantasy radar.

The Jets elevated Shepard from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports. The move gives the Jets much-needed depth at wide receiver given the absences of both Omar Cooper (ankle) and Isaiah Williams (ribs) for Sunday's game against the Chargers. It will be the third elevation of the season for Shepard and first since Week 4 against the Bears, so he would need to be signed to the 53-man roster in order to suit up for the Jets beyond Week 11.

Shepard reverted to the Jets' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log. Shepard was on the field for 17 of the Jets' 32 offensive snaps as the team finished with a time possession of 17:15, and he failed to haul in his lone target from Geno Smith. It was the second time this season that the veteran wide receiver was promoted from the practice squad, and he's eligible for one more elevation before the Jets would be required to sign him to the active roster. Shepard could be brought up for Week 5 against the Browns on Oct. 11 if Adonai Mitchell (finger) is not cleared to play.

The Jets elevated Shepard from their practice squad to their active roster Saturday. Shepard is set to suit up on game day for the second straight week. Last Sunday in Detroit, the veteran wideout logged a healthy workload of 30 offensive snaps -- third-most among New York wideouts -- and caught his only target for three yards. Shepard could also garner a significant role this Sunday due to Adonai Mitchell again being ruled out due to a finger injury.

Shepard reverted to the Jets' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log. In his first action of the season, Shepard played 30 of 66 offensive snaps in Sunday's loss to the Lions, though he was targeted just one time. With Adonai Mitchell (finger) battling an injury, Shepard could again be elevated ahead of next Sunday's game against the Bears. He has no fantasy appeal.

The Jets elevated Shepard from the practice squad to the active roster Saturday, Zack Rosenblatt of The Athletic reports. Shepard is set to suit up as the No. 6 wide receiver for the Jets in Sunday's game against the Lions. The new practice squad face was elevated for a scenario where Adonai Mitchell (finger) is unable to play in Sunday's contest. If Mitchell receives the green light, Shepard may spend his first elevation with the team inactive.

The Jets signed Shepard to the practice squad Tuesday, Mike Garafolo of NFL Network reports. Shepard failed to make the Texans' 53-man roster at the end of training camp after signing with the team Aug. 21. He'll get a fresh opportunity with the Jets, and he's a candidate to be elevated to the active roster for Week 2 against the Jets if rookie first-rounder Omar Cooper (ankle) is unable to play. Shepard appeared in 13 regular-season games for the Buccaneers in 2025, finishing with a 39-371-1 receiving line on 53 targets while adding four carries for 19 yards.

items.h: Sterling Shepard signs with Jets practice squad
items.s: The Jets signed WR Sterling Shepard to their practice squad. Sheppard joins the Jets with Omar Cooper week-to-week.
